observations: The archetype selection remained a flat planning polygon before Generate to 3D.

The first parcel was smaller than the explicit civic-plaza compatibility envelope; the park was tested on a minimally enlarged valid parcel rather than scaling the fountain or inventing an oversized element.
Generate to 3D persisted the exact Batch 21 family, variant, appearance kit, planting structure and metric target.
The compiled parcel base uses the exact Green Civic paver PBR skin instead of the generic plaza material.
The depth kit adds one central fountain, six paired raised planting terraces, rain-garden planting, timber seating, perimeter trees and civic microdetail while retaining a clear event field.
The level prepared park datum masks the Google tiles without source geometry protruding through the parcel.
The separately compiled building remained independent from the park family throughout the trial.
